_comment: Letters left in the home by outside authority. Edit freely. The runtime mirrors this in js/letters.js (INLINE constant) because file:// can't fetch — keep both in sync, or run the site via a local server and the JSON becomes live.

letters.preface: There is a paper next to YOUR CHILD.
letters.body:
NOTICE OF WELFARE VISIT
Case file pending. Reference number to follow.

The minor identified as YOUR CHILD was observed unattended for the duration my visit (approx. 18 minutes). No legal guardian present.

The premises were entered under authority of §4.966.3 (Childrens' Spiritual & Wellness Services). YOUR CHILD did not cry. I do not know what to do with that.

A follow-up will be scheduled with you degenerates.
I recommend you leave.

 - Agent Gabriel, CSWS.

letters.preface: Somone has written on YOUR CHILD with a Sharpie marker.
letters.body:
NOTICE OF WELFARE VISIT
YOU FUCKING BITCH!.

I told you to leave!

Please be advised THIS matter remains open.

Degenerate behavior will be punished.

 - Agent Gabriel, CSWS.

letters.preface: There is a black sedan parked across the street.
letters.body:
It has been there since Tuesday.

The plates are obscured by what looks like deliberate damage. He has not gotten out.

When you wave he does not wave back. The engine has been running the whole time.

letters.preface: A deck of cards on the porch.
letters.body:
Sealed. But the wrapper is torn at the corner and the deck has already been cut.

Whoever shuffled it knew what they were doing.

You put it in the drawer with the others. There are others now.

When you picked up there was breathing.

He waited. Then he hung up.

The number was unlisted. The carrier has no record of the call. The child asked who it was. You said nobody.

letters.preface: A chair pulled up to the kitchen table.
letters.body:
You did not put it there.

The chair is still warm. Someone sat in it long enough for the wood to take their body heat.

The deck of cards is on the table in front of it. Shuffled. Cut. Waiting.
